balls.text: holes out in the deep, slower one bowled short on middle, didn't time it well enough as he went for the pull, found Manhas running in from deep midwicket
length ball outside off, drilled down the ground to long-on
yorker length outside off, tried to swipe it over midwicket, missed
full toss outside off, makes room and carts it wide of deep cover, firmly struck but didn't find the gap
excellent shot, meaty, length delivery on leg stump, comes down, gets under it and strikes it cleanly over long-on for a big one
fullish outside off, dug out wide of cover for a quick signle
full toss on middle and leg, chipped just short of mid-off for a quick single
banged in short outside off, makes room and slashes it wide of third man for two more
slower one bowled at 118.2 kmph, pushed away towards long-off for a single
nicely done, full outside off, drives it uppishly wide of long-off for a couple more
good length just a fraction outside leg, makes room to heave it over midwicket, misses
length ball on middle, makes room and drives it powerfully towards mid-off where a dive saves a few runs
Agarkar has done well, full toss on middle, atrocious delivery but you still have to deal with it, pulls it away fiercely over deep midwicket for a flat six

dropped, failed to pick the slower one, came down the track to slap it over the bowler's head, mistimed it and Bhatia failed to cup it running back, twisted his ankle but nothing serious, they take a couple
short of a length outside off, cut away to deep point for a single
slower one bowled on a good length on middle, plays the chip again, seems to favour it, into the gap between long-on and long-off
slower legcutter, pushed wide of point for a single
length ball on the off, chips it to long-off for a single
banged in short outside off, an attempted bouncer, backs away from it
slower one bowled short on middle, makes room to guide it down to third man, misses
mid-on was up, and he cleared him comfortably, low full toss on leg stump, makes room and chips it over the in-field to get four more
slower one bowled short outside off, edged away over the slips for a single to third man
short of a good length outside off, tries to slap it back past the bowler, mistimes it, drops it wide of the pitch and gets a single, and another one on the overthrow
Ganguly goes! Failed to pick the slower, unlike his partner in the last over made room to crash that over long-off, ended up miscuing it straight to point where Warner took a dolly
slower one bowled full outside off, Agarkar is in good nick here, picks it well and lofts it between deep midwicket and long-on for a boundary, important runs these, inching towards 100
yorker on the off stump, dug out back to the bowler
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, played wide of cover for a single
pushed away over point wide of deep cover for a quick couple
short of a good length outside off, makes room and chips it in the massive gap between deep cover and long-off, times it well enough to get four
good length outside off, gets to the pitch and drives it down to deep cover
short and wide, guided down to third man for a single
short of a length outside off, in the slot to play his beloved cut over point, missed it
back of a length outside off, dabbed it behind point but there's no single available
bouncer banged in on the off stump, Ganguly ducks under it well
on target, hurling it on middle, defended into the leg side
good length on leg stump, flicked away in the gap wide of deep midwicket for a couple
short of a length outside off, too wide, chops it down to third man
tossed up outside off, drives it straight to extra cover
pushed to cover off the back foot
googly, short on middle and spun into leg stump, went for the pull, stuck high on the pads
tossed up outside leg and spun into the left hander, turned wide of short fine
takes full toll, bowled it quick, flat and short on middle, Ganguly was expecting that, picked the length early, rocked back and pulled it well over long-on for a massive six
oversteps, freehit time, tries to work it away, struck on the pads
shortish outside off, comes down, hangs his bat out and plays it towards deep point
short of a length, makes room and chops it to point
flighted on the off stump, reaches forward and plays it to extra cover
short of a length outside off, bunts it down wide of deep cover
missed run out, pushed wide of point, calls for a single and sends him back when Agarkar is halfway down the pitch, a throw to the  non-striker's end that Dilshan misses, an opportunity gone begging
tossed up on middle, bunts it down the ground to long-on
on middle and leg, turned away behind square for a single
short of a good length on middle, defended to cover
spun away as he tried to fish for it just outside off, beat the outside edge
flighted on middle, pushed back to the bowler
tries to tickle it fine, clips the pads and rolls behind square for a couple of leg byes

stumped, excellent effort from Karthik, was the googly, he failed to pick it, came down the track to a flighted delivery, tried to heave it over midwicket, was done in by the flight, Karthik took it well wide of leg stump, stretched to clip the bails with Henriques well short, not quite the acrobatic stuff that he pulled off to dismiss Michael Vaughan in England a few years back but a quality effort nevertheless
googly on the off stump, driven down wide of long-off for a single
spinning in, defended off the back foot to the bowler
gets on the back foot and bunts it down to deep cover
spinning into middle and off, bent low to sweep, was rapped on the pads and Dilshan went up immediately, the umpire shook his head, was he struck outside the line?
tossed up on middle, defended watchfully into the leg side

appeal for run out, never run on a misfield they say, Ganguly pushed one to point, Warner fumbled but recovered well to hurl one down to the non-striker's end, Dilshan took down the stumps as Henriques was stretching to make it back, the bails came off only when he had dragged his bat just inside the crease, a difference of one frame
short of a length outside off, pushed away firmly wide of a diving cover for a couple
flighted on the off stump, played back to the bowler
slightly short outside off, bends down and chops it down to point
googly, drew him out of the crease and he dropped it on the off side with bat close to pad
flighted outside off, square-drives it towards deep point
not giving him any room, spun back in from middle, pushed to cover
attempts a paddle past the keeper, is hot on the pads and the ball drops into the leg side
tossed up, lands on a length outside off, driven down to long-off
slightly short on middle, gets back and punches it down to long-on
fullish on middle and leg, played back to the bowler
drifting into middle and off, dropped short of point and cover for a single
flighted outside off, reaches forward and drives it down to long-off
short outside off, gets back and bunts it down to deep cover
a tame dismissal that, a first-ball duck, flighted on leg stump, tried to sweep it fine, got the top-edge and the ball lobbed up to Karthik who took it gleefully
tosses it up, eased through the covers for a single
spun back in sharply from outside off, pushed off the back foot to the bowler

flighted outside off, Yashpal was tempted, Mishra drew him into playing an attacking shot, tried to clear the ropes but didn't time it well enough to do so, found Rajat Bhatia stationed there exactly for that shot, caught at deep extra-cover
flighted on middle, takes it on the full and bunts it to long-off
tossed up outside off, slapped away to deep cover for a single
played away wide of point for a single, a bit of hesitation but there was always a single in there
on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler
on middle and leg, worked away, gets across and pushes it towards deep midwicket
drifting it into middle from round the wicket, waited for it to spin and dabbed it onto the pitch
too short, and wide, rocks back and cuts it away fiercely wide of a diving point for a boundary
on middle and leg, defended into the off side
Yashpal gets into the cut, the first boundary was mistimed but this was struck hard, short and wide, makes room to cart it over point
teasing him outside off again, inviting him to drive but Ganguly is cautious, dabbing it through the covers for a single
was in the slot, full outside off, Ganguly went after it, looked to cream it through the covers but the ball swung away to beat the bat, the umpire thought it was too wide, I didn't
on middle and moving in further, dabbed between mid-off and cover for a quick single
too close to cut despite making some room, chops it down to cover
bowled on a length outside off, crunched it over the covers, didn't time it all too well but it had enough on it to roll down to the ropes
fullish on the off, pushed wide of mid-off for a quick single
shortish on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler
short of a good length on the off, pushed away to point
drifting on the pads, turned away towards fine leg off the hips
came back in, moved back and guided it wide of Warner at point for a single
held it back, bowled it short outside off, slashed away to third man for a single
A Dada special, length ball outside off, took a couple of steps down the track, made room and smashed it over the deep-cover boundary
back of a length, tried to cut that over point, the shot was on but he didn't connect
zipped away, good pace, 139.7 kmph, chased it from the crease, played it away from his body, the movement just beat the outside edge
a length ball on middle and leg, pushed through the line to mid-on
on middle and leg, defended off the back foot onto the pitch
missed out there, bowled on a length on the pads, could have tickled it fine but was struck on the pads
bowled at 138.1 kmph, a teasing line just marginally outside off, defended short of mid-off and sets off for a single
angling it into leg stump, dropped wide of mid-on and scampers off
getting some movement into the batsmen with some consistency, pushed wide of midwicket for a single to get off the mark
good length on the off, moved back in just a bit, defended to cover off the back foot
banged in short, a bouncer outside off, given a wide, a touch too high
cramping him there, bang on the stumps, moves back and defends, bowled at 136.3 kmph
finds the gap nicely, just a firm push between point and cover, waited for it to move away and just tapped it into the gap
good length on the off, leaving the left-hander, hangs his bat out and defends to point
angling into middle and leg, worked away, along the ground to square leg this time
that was thought out, excellent field placement, short on middle, goes for the pull, plays it straight to a shortish square leg where Rajat Bhatia takes it neatly
good length outside off and came back in a touch, left alone to the keeper
down the leg side this time, a decent pace, 135.4 kmph, but misdirected, given a wide
banged it in a touch short on middle, gets back and tickles it behind square for a single
a touch too wide outside off, Ganguly restrains himself, lets it go
in the channel outside off, moves away a hint, leaves it be

he's gone! Tempting him outside off, a hint of a way movement, he's sucked into the drive, pushes at it with minimal footwork, gets a thick edge and AB de Villiers at a widish slip takes a simple catch
came back in, pitched on middle and off, driven to mid-on
landed on a good length outside off, left alone to the keeper

he's given him!! Nehra was the only guy who appealed, landed on a good length on middle and angled away, McCullum moved across to play it away on the leg side, was struck on the pads but it was clearly missing off. Suresh Shastri raises his finger, a poor decision
nervy Nehra strays it down the leg side this time, held its line, concedes a wide
banged it in short, rocked back and pulled it away powerfully over square leg, a flat six that, a crowd-killer
nipping back in, landed on a good length on the off and came back in, punched to midwicket off the back foot
dismissed, short on the off, pulled away disdainfully through midwicket to seal Kolkata's fate
yorker targeting middle, nicely bowled, but he was able to bring his bat down in time, got an inside edge wide of square leg for a single
hurls a wide way wide of the off stump, one more to the score, and they're just one hit away
banged in short on the off, rolls his wrists over it to pull it to deep square leg
back of a length outside off, struck well, slapped it down to deep cover
he's hastening the win now, in the slot on middle and leg, got under it and drilled it down the ground wide of mid-on for a boundary
back of a length on the off, worked away gently wide of midwicket, there's enough time for them to come back for the second
short of a good length outside off, opens the face to guide it down to third man
angling it into middle, get back, drops it in the midwicket region for a single to keep the strike
drifting into leg stump, comes down the track and drives it down to deep midwicket
struck hard, slightly short on the off, had a bit of pace on it as well, rocked back, made room and crashed it through the cover region for a boundary, only a matter of time now
flighted on middle and off, dropped short of midwicket for an easy single
quickish delivery on the off stump, walks across and punches it between long-on and deep midwicket for a couple more
looping into middle, makes room and drives that inside out over cover for a single
slightly short on the off, works it away wristily wide of deep square leg for a couple to bring up the 100 for Delhi
yorker outside off, bowled at 140.5 kmph, Karthik, trying to open the face, could not get his bat down in time
banged in short on middle, pulled away stylishly to deep square leg
angling it into the pads, flicked away to fine leg for a single
on middle and off, turns it wide of mid-on for a quick single
back of a length on middle, tucked away behind square towards fine leg

beautifully timed, good length on the off, plays it with a straight bat, finding the gap between deep cover and long-off, a diving effort in the deep should have dragged it back but instead the fielder palmed it off the the boundary
fullish on the off again, aiming for the yorker, at 131 kmph, dug out to cover
fullish again, square-driven well but straight to Hodge at point
half-volley on the off stump, presents the full face to drive it down to long-off
short of a length on the off, rocks back and pulls it away in that massive gap between long-on and deep midwicket
too short, too wide, Karthik missed out, went for the cut, but ended up under-edging it to the keeper
tossed up on middle and was drifting down leg, was struck on the pads as he tried to hit that through the line, stifled appeal turned down
arm ball again, on middle, tickled towards short fine for a quick run
slower through the air, rocks back and bunts it down to deep cover
short of a good length on the off, was the arm ball, punched straight to cover
short outside off, spins away, he goes for the pull, misses, so does the keeper and they get two byes
short of a length outside off, cut away to point
fullish on the off stump, defended watchfully to point, yells against a single
bowled on a length on the of, crunched through the off side to deep cover
induced the outside edge, probing him outside off, he pushed at it hard, got a thick edge perfectly in the gap between keeper and a widish slip, unlucky

excellent fielding and he almost caused a run out, slapped towards Hodge at point who dived full length to his right and hurled it at the stumps at the non-striker's end but Karthik dived to make it back
fullish on the off, uses his wrists to drive it down to long-on
short of a good length outside off, chopped down towards deep point for a single
lands full on middle, driven down to long-on for a single
flighted on middle and off, defended back to the bowler
slower through the air, landed on a good length on the off, tried to sweep it square, was hit on the hips, big appeal but that was a touch too high and was probably missing off
drifting into the off stump, landed full on the off, pushed to cover
short and wide, cut away to deep point for a single
on middle and off, waited for it to spin away, pushed it wide of point for a single
short of a good length outside off, left alone
length ball outside off, waits for it, opens the face to guide it behind point wide of third man, Ishant is a little late to get onto it and they run back for the second
length ball on the off, drops it short of cover and calls for a single, is sent back rightly
back of a length on the off, rocks back and defends it watchfully to mid-off
much fuller, brought it back in, teasing him outside off, left it alone, he's calm
shaping  away from the right hander, moved away, left alone to the keeper

Superb catch by Henriques, held his cool till the end, banged in short on middle, Dilshan pulled it away and for a while it seemed it would clear the ropes comfortably, Henriques at fine leg, bent low, turned back and judged it to perfection inches in front of the boundary
easily done, back of a length on the off, guided down to third man, Agarkar returns an accurate throw to the striker's end
banged it in short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg, the mexican wave is in full flow here
down the leg side, chases it but he gets a wide anyway
edged and gone, bowled at 139.5 kmph, bent low to drill that through the off side, got a thick edge to the keeper, Ishant had a few things to say to Warner as he walked back
just a fraction short on the off, picks the length early and back-slaps that past the bowler all along the ground to beat mid-on, powerfully struck
fullish on middle and leg, driven wide of midwicket into the gap between long-on and deep midwicket
driven firmly towards cover where a diving save prevents at least a couple of runs
flighted on leg stump, closes the face and drops it wide of square leg, it's in the gap and some lethargic fielding in the leg side allows them to scramble back for the second
short of a length on leg stump, plays a short-arm pull to deep square leg
short of a length on the off, walked across and pushed it wide of the bowler for a single
flighted full on the off, pushed down the ground to long-off
tossed up on the off, pushed back to the bowler
slower one bowled short on the off, didn't time it well, pulled it uppishly towards long-on for a single
tempting line outside off, opens the face and square-drives it towards deep point
gone, slid it full outside off, Gambhir was tempted, reached for it and steered it uppishly straight to Hodge at point
bowled full on leg stump, driven crisply down the ground to long-on
bouncer banged in short on middle, too high, Warner didn't even have to duck, by the way, they've already added 50
shot, just a fraction short on the off, comes down the track and pulls it away wide of Ganguly at long-on, in the gap between him and deep midwicket, Warner in an attacking mood
straight on leg stump, tries to defend it on the pitch but finds the inside edge, rolled just wide of leg stump
bowled flat outside leg, tries to turn it fine, flicks the pads on the way to the keeper
flighted on middle, struck back to the bowler, a quietish over this
tossed up on the off, pushed to cover off the front foot
tossed up outside off, closes the face and turns it to midwicket
tossed up on middle and leg, worked away towards deep midwicket
defended into the leg side, bowling from round the wicket, into middle and leg
spoils his debut with a contemptous strike over mid-on, meaty, length ball outside off, enough room to free his arms and smashes the poor Sarkar for a one bounce four
good length on middle and leg, closes the face to work it behind square for a single
they're doing it easily here, not the best of starts to a debut, full on middle and leg, executes an excellent on-drive in the gap between midwicket and mid-on
picked the gap, length ball outside off, made room and drilled that past a diving cover to beat mid-off to the boundary
fullish on leg stump, tried to drive that past midwicket, struck on the pads, gets a quick single, an inside edge onto the pads
good pace first up for a medium pacer, 131 kmph, guided down to third man for a single
good length on middle and off, drilled down to mid-off, mistimed it there, his intention was to clear the fielder
landed on a good length on middle and moved down, struck high on the pads as he tried to turn it away
struck flat, short and wide, poor ball, bowling to his strength, stayed his ground, slashed hard and cleared the ropes with ease, Delhi are well on track here
back of a length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single
poor line, angling it into the pads, tried to clip it fine, brushed the pads on the way to the fine-leg boundary
much closer to the off stump, pushed off the back foot to point
straying down the leg side, given a wide, tried to tickle it fine but didn't made contact, the keeper fumbled and they get another run
taps it straight to McCullum  at cover, well timed
gives him width and he flashes hard but misses, he gets some late seam movement
gets forward and drives hard but finds cover
chops it down towards cover points
the same suicidal line and length - wide and short - easy for Gambhir as he whacks it over backward point
he slashes hard and places it straight to point
drops it towards short cover and calls for the run quickly, Gambhir is quick to respond and the throw to the batsman's end is wide
134 kph, skids through to the batsman and he chops it back to the bowler
cuts but doesn't time it very well, the fielder at backward point slides and cuts it off
much better as he fires a yorker on middle stump, Warnet just manages to dig it out
Henriques isn't learning from his mistake, he drops it too short again and gifts him with width outside off, he slashes over backward point and beats square third man
he drops it short and he plays a short-arm jab past the huge gap between midwicket and mid-on
he pushes it towards cover point and the ball travels pretty quickly
he flays hard back towards mid-on but he mistimes the shot
well left this time, he keeps it outside off and gets good bounce and carry to the keeper
he makes room and tries to carve it over cover but he doesn't make contact
he pushes it towards extra cover and sets off quickly and the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end
keeps it full on middle and off and Gambhir drops it towards mid-off with soft hands and sets off
lands it wide outside off and he safely lets it go
